rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Skinfaxi, the Norse horse whose shining mane lights the sky and earth. Native square PNG at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: one horse head, two eyes, four hooved legs, no wings or horns; mane and tail shining like gold; simple chariot traces taut behind it, chariot only a small partial edge with no driver visible [skinfaxi-c01, skinfaxi-c02]
MOMENT: SURGE past the low viewer through the sky, forelegs thrust forward in a powerful mid-gallop, neck bent and eye intent
POWER: golden light originates in actual mane and tail hairs, illuminating cloud faces and the dark earth far below; not flame breath or magical ribbons [skinfaxi-c01, skinfaxi-c02, skinfaxi-c09]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortened framing; no invented gigantic size
LIGHT & WEATHER: mane itself is the sole dominant golden light, deep twilight cloud shadows, physical airborne droplets
SURFACE: coarse mane strands, short horse coat and worn harness
SETTING: sky traversed by the horse of Day, earth visible beneath [skinfaxi-c01]
MOOD: imposing and awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the documented character; never cute, calm or decorative. The creature itself dominates and remains striking at 200 pixels.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, coloured magic mist or energy ribbons. Bracketed claim IDs are instructions, never visible text.
depicted_variant: Skinfaxi drawing Day through the sky, gold-shining mane and tail account.

visual_requirements.description: Horse; gold-shining mane and tail; harnessed to Day chariot

aura: Awe comes from light shed by the gold-shining mane onto sky and earth (skinfaxi-c01, skinfaxi-c02, skinfaxi-c09).
artistic_choices: White-grey coat and simple unadorned traces are editorial; no claim of canonical coat colour. Close camera creates dominance without enlarging the horse. Driver deliberately excluded because his iconography is not specified.

visual_review.notes: Viewed native and actual 200px thumbnail. All seven checks pass: horse fills frame with galloping foreshortened hooves, one head and natural two-eye/four-leg anatomy; mane and tail blaze with documented golden illumination across sky and earth. Taut harness/chariot edge present. No wings, horns, text, logos, gore or generic aura. Extraordinary celestial daylight horse remains immediately legible at 200px.

root_visual_review.notes: Harnessed white horse with a blazing golden mane pulling Day's chariot across the sky, its light falling on the earth below.
